create_FAIRChemCalculator_from_checkpoin: create a FAIRChemCalculator from a pretrained model checkpoint file using from_model_checkpoint class method
run_formation_energy_calculation: run a FormationEnergyCalculator to compute formation energies by wrapping a base ASE calculator with element references
calculate_energy_forces_stress: calculate energy, forces, and stress properties for an ASE Atoms object using the FAIRChemCalculator calculate method
check_atoms_pbc_validation: check an ASE Atoms object for invalid periodic boundary conditions using the _check_atoms_pbc method
apply_mp_style_corrections: apply Materials Project style corrections to formation energies using the FormationEnergyCalculator with correction_type parameter
